description: This file appears to be a shell test script that verifies the behavior of 'git ls-files' with --exclude-standard, --exclude, and --ignored options. It creates a repository, adds files, modifies them, and checks the output of 'git ls-files' to ensure exclude patterns are correctly applied.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Defines a function that runs 'git ls-files' with specific options and compares the output with expected results.

methods.name: check_all_output
methods.description: Calls 'check_output' multiple times to verify repository state under different conditions.
